companyDescription: Space Launch + Systems · Only at-scale public small/medium launch company outside SpaceX — Electron rocket (LEO workhorse) + Neutron in dev + space systems components. Picks & shovels of the commercial + defense space era.
priceNote: Jun 23 pre-mkt $95.59 (-4.7%) from $100.29 Jun 22 close — down ~36% from ATH $151 (late May) on SpaceX IPO capital rotation + SVP insider selling $9.5M Jun 18. NOW touching preferred entry zone.
summary: Rocket Lab is the only publicly-traded at-scale launch + space systems company beyond SpaceX. Revenue growing 52% YoY to ~$916M est FY2026, gross margins expanding from 34% → 40%+. The Jun 2026 selloff (-36% from ATH) is SpaceX IPO capital rotation — NOT fundamental deterioration. Q2 earnings Aug 6 and pending Nasdaq-100 inclusion are near-term re-rating catalysts. Insider selling (SVP $9.5M Jun 18) is the primary watch risk.
